Kinetic Green Energy & Power Solutions Limited (founder, CEO) |spouse = Manish Motwani | father = [[Arun Firodia]] | relatives = [[H. K. Firodia]] (grandfather) }} '''Sulajja Firodia Motwani''' (born 26 August 1970) is an Indian entrepreneur. She is currently the vice-chairperson of [[Kinetic Engineering Limited]] and is the founder and CEO of Kinetic Green Energy & Power Solutions Limited. The Kinetic Group witnessed expansion during her term, offering a range of [[Automotive industry in India|two wheelers]] right from [[mopeds]], [[Scooter (motorcycle)|scooters]] to [[motorcycles]]. She has recently restructured the group to expand group activities into automotive systems and green energy. Most notably, she has founded a company, Kinetic Green Energy and Power Solutions, that aims to launch electric autos, buggies and small electric taxis.{{cite web|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/aim-to-raise-revenue-to-rs-500cr3-years-kinetic-motors_645531.html|title=Aim to raise revenue to Rs 500cr in 3 years: Kinetic Motors|publisher=MoneyControl.com|date= |accessdate=12 December 2013}}{{cite web|url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=23926838&ticker=KNH:IN|archive-url=https://archive.today/20131212073409/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=23926838&ticker=KNH:IN|url-status=dead|archive-date=12 December 2013|title=Kinetic Motor Co Ltd (KNH:Natl India)|publisher=Bloomberg Businessweek|date= |accessdate=12 December 2013}} ==Early life== Sulajja was born on 26 August 1970. She completed her graduation in Commerce from [[Brihan Maharashtra College of Commerce]], [[Pune University]] in 1990. She is an MBA holder from [[Carnegie Mellon University]] in [[Pittsburgh]].{{Cite web|title=Meet the poster-girl of mass EV mobility in India: Sulajja Firodia Motwani of the Kinetic Legacy – Outlook Business WoW|url=https://wow.outlookbusiness.com/sulajja-firodia-motwani/|access-date=2020-12-10|language=en-US}} She is the granddaughter of H. K. Firodia, founder of [[Kinetic Engineering]] and the daughter of [[Arun Firodia]], founder and present Chairman of the Arun Firodia Group (Not affiliated with the Dr. Abhay Firodia Group - Force Motors, Jaya Hind Industries) . Throughout her studies, she has been a rank holder. Her name appeared in the toppers list in the [[Secondary School Certificate|SSC]] examinations and she topped the state in [[Higher Secondary School Certificate|HSC]] examinations. She was a vice-president for a youth run organization, [[AIESEC]] in Pune for which she is currently a board advisor.{{cite web|url=http://www.in.com/sulajja-motwani/biography-390261.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131215050111/http://www.in.com/sulajja-motwani/biography-390261.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=15 December 2013|title=BUSINESS LEADERS SULAJJA MOTWANI |publisher=in.com|date= |accessdate=12 December 2013}} ==Personal life== Sulajja is married to Manish Motwani and is the mother to a 19-year-old son, Sidhant. She is a fitness enthusiast and a marathon runner. She has been [[enthusiastic]] about [[sports]] especially [[badminton]]. She is also fond of pursuing [[adventurous]] [[sports]] like [[skiing]], sky diving and [[scuba diving]].{{cite web|url=http://ekikrat.in/Sulajja-Firodia-Motwani|title=Sulajja Firodia Motwani|publisher=Ekikrat.in|date= |accessdate=12 December 2013}} ==Career== She recently formed a JV with Tonino Lamborghini, SpA, to bring global design and technology for electric and solar golf carts and tourism vehicles, which will be manufactured in India and marketed globally.{{citation needed|date=January 2022}} She is also the Vice Chairperson of Kinetic Engineering Ltd. She is responsible for Kinetic group's overall business strategy and development. Kinetic Group's business interests include Automobile Manufacturing, auto components including Powertrain Systems, Green Energy, Multilevel parking solutions, Elevators & Escalators. Kinetic's partners include companies like Hyundai, Lamborghini, Taigene Electrical, Magna etc.{{citation needed|date=January 2022}} Before joining [[Kinetic Engineering Limited|Kinetic Motor Company]], she worked for a period of four years with an investment [[analytics]] company, BARRA International, based in California. She played a major role in setting the operations of the [[Kinetic Engineering Limited|Kinetic Motor Company]] in India. Sulajja played a major role in designing and implementing new strategies for the company. She is also performing the role of the [[Director (business)|Director]] of [[Kinetic Engineering Limited|Kinetic Motor Company]] and Kinetic Green Energy limited. She is in charge of the Group's overall business [[developmental]] activities.{{citation needed|date=January 2022}} ==References== {{reflist}} == External links == *[http://www.iloveindia.com/indian-heroes/sulaijja-firodia-motwani.html Indian Entrepreneurs:Sulajja Firodia Motwani] {{DEFAULTSORT:Motwani, Sulajja Firodia}} [[Category:1970 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Indian women philanthropists]] [[Category:Indian philanthropists]] [[Category:Businesspeople from Pune]] [[Category:Businesswomen from Maharashtra]] [[Category:Savitribai Phule Pune University alumni]] [[Category:20th-century Indian businesspeople]] [[Category:20th-century Indian businesswomen]] [[Category:21st-century Indian businesswomen]] [[Category:21st-century Indian businesspeople]]
